elements.description:
A message box that takes images, audio, video and documents: upload state and progress, previews, format and size
checks, and the app's token estimates per attachment and in total.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The attachments. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: text
properties.description: The message. Changed by the user unless a tc-text-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: placeholder
properties.default: "Write a message, or drop files here"

properties.name: label
properties.description: Names the message box for screen readers

properties.name: accept
properties.description: What it accepts: extensions (".pdf"), MIME types ("image/png") or families ("audio/*"); unset accepts any file

properties.name: maxSize
properties.description: The largest file, in bytes, for any kind without its own limit

properties.name: limits
properties.description: The largest file per kind, in bytes – { video: 200 * 1024 * 1024 }

properties.name: budget
properties.description: The token budget for the attachments; over it, Send waits. Unset shows the total alone

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The attachments changed ({ value, change }: MultimodalValueChange – change is { type: "add", files } with each new File, { type: "remove", attachment } or { type: "clear" } after a send); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-text-change
events.description: The message was edited ({ text }: MultimodalTextChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `text`

events.name: tc-send
events.description: Send was pressed, or Enter in the message ({ text, attachments }: MultimodalSend); cancelable – prevented, the box keeps its text and attachments

events.name: tc-retry
events.description: Retry was pressed on an attachment that failed ({ attachment, file }: MultimodalRetry – `file` when it was added here)

events.name: tc-reject
events.description: Files were turned away ({ rejections }: MultimodalReject)

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds files as if they were dropped: checks each, turns away what doesn't fit, and fires tc-value-change for the rest

functions.name: multimodalKind
functions.signature: multimodalKind(file: { name: string; type?: string }): MultimodalKind
functions.description: What kind of attachment a file is: from its MIME type, else its extension

functions.name: formatBytes
functions.description: "840 KB", "2.4 MB" – number and unit joined by a no-break space

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The attachments on mount when `value` isn't controlled

props.name: onChange
props.description: The attachments changed; `change.files` holds the new File objects to upload

props.name: defaultText
props.description: The message on mount when `text` isn't controlled

props.name: onSend
props.description: Send was pressed, or Enter in the message; the box then clears unless it's controlled

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry was pressed on an attachment that failed; `file` when it was added in this box

props.name: onReject
props.description: Files were turned away, with the reasons
